### Executive Summary
- Multiple **pre-auth / unauth** compromise paths surfaced with PoC or strong exploitation risk: **N-able N-central “god-mode” takeover**, **TeamCity on‑prem unauth RCE**, and **Gitea/CodeIgniter pre-auth RCE PoCs** (CI/CD + admin tools = high blast radius).
- **macOS infostealer campaign (MacSync)** abusing **fake Claude install guides + “paste this in Terminal”** social engineering—relevant for exec/dev endpoints and BYOD.
- New auth/credential-abuse weaknesses highlighted (e.g., **PaperCut brute-force + user enumeration**)—treat as a **credential-stuffing readiness** prompt.

---

### High-priority items (immediate attention)

**1) N-able N-central critical takeover (incl. incomplete patch / account takeover)**
- What happened: Critical N-central issues reported enabling **unauth “god-mode” admin access**; separate CVE notes **incomplete patch leading to auth bypass/account takeover** (CVE-2026-18577).
- Why it matters operationally: RMM console compromise is a **fleet-wide control-plane breach** (rapid lateral movement, script execution, ransomware staging).
- Recommended immediate actions for the SOC today: **Identify any N-central exposure** (cloud/on‑prem, internet-facing), **confirm patched version beyond 2026.3.1 + vendor mitigations**, and **alert on new/changed admin users, API tokens, or unexpected automation jobs** in N-central audit logs.

**2) JetBrains TeamCity On-Prem critical unauth RCE (CVE-2026-63077)**
- What happened: Public analysis of a **critical unauth server compromise** path in TeamCity on‑prem (insecure deserialization via agent polling protocol).
- Why it matters operationally: CI/CD compromise enables **code theft, pipeline tampering, signing key access**, and direct pivot into prod (financial-sector supply-chain risk).
- Recommended immediate actions for the SOC today: **Inventory TeamCity instances**, **verify patch level/mitigation** and restrict management interfaces; **hunt for new service accounts, new build agents, unexpected plugin installs, and outbound connections from TeamCity hosts**.

**3) Pre-auth RCE PoCs in common dev/web stacks (Gitea + CodeIgniter)**
- What happened: PoCs published for **Gitea pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-60004)** and **CodeIgniter 4 file upload RCE (CVE-2026-63223; fixed in 4.7.4)**.
- Why it matters operationally: These platforms often sit in **dev networks with secrets**; PoC availability increases opportunistic scanning and “smash-and-grab” compromise.
- Recommended immediate actions for the SOC today: **Scan externally reachable surfaces** for Gitea/CodeIgniter apps; **block/monitor suspicious upload endpoints and abnormal POST patterns**, and **prioritize patching/isolating internet-facing instances**.

**4) macOS “paste into Terminal” infostealer (MacSync) via fake Claude guidance**
- What happened: Campaign uses **paid search + fake Claude installation guide** to trick users into **running a Terminal command** that installs MacSync stealer.
- Why it matters operationally: Likely leads to **credential/session theft** (browser creds, wallet data); high risk for **exec/dev Mac endpoints** with privileged SaaS access.
- Recommended immediate actions for the SOC today: **Notify IT/SOC floor** to treat “Claude install” searches as suspicious; **hunt for unusual shell execution chains** (Terminal → curl/bash, osascript, launch agents) on macOS EDR and **force re-auth + token revocation** for affected users.

---

### Monitoring & detection recommendations
- **RMM/remote admin abuse (N-central)**: Monitor **N-central audit logs + IdP logs** for new admin creation, role changes, token creation, mass device tasking (MITRE: **T1098 Account Manipulation**, **T1059 Command and Scripting Interpreter**).
- **CI/CD compromise signals (TeamCity/Gitea)**: From **CI server logs + EDR on CI hosts**, alert on new agents, plugin installs, build config changes, credential store access; watch **egress** to unusual destinations (MITRE: **T1195 Supply Chain Compromise**, **T1552 Unsecured Credentials**).
- **External scanning/attempted exploitation**: On **WAF/reverse proxy/firewall**, look for spikes in requests to **/login, /api, /upload, git hook endpoints, TeamCity agent polling paths**; correlate with 4xx/5xx bursts and new source ASNs (MITRE: **T1595 Active Scanning**).
- **macOS stealer execution patterns**: In **macOS EDR + MDM logs**, hunt for Terminal spawning **curl/wget/python/bash**, creation of **LaunchAgents/LaunchDaemons**, or new persistence items (MITRE: **T1059**, **T1543.001**, **T1547**).
- **Credential stuffing readiness (PaperCut + general)**: In **IdP/VPN/app auth logs**, alert on high-rate failures, distributed login attempts, and timing/user-enum patterns; ensure lockout/MFA challenges are triggering (MITRE: **T1110 Brute Force**).
- **Oracle WebCenter Portal criticals (CVE-2026-60561/60563/60566)**: If present, monitor **web/app logs** for unusual Runtime Tools access, new privileged sessions, and unexpected process spawns on the app server (MITRE: **T1068 Privilege Escalation**, **T1190 Exploit Public-Facing App**).
- **Linux local privesc noise (kernel/PackageKit)**: On **Linux EDR/auditd**, alert on PackageKit D-Bus transactions, unexpected package installs, and privilege escalations from low-priv users (MITRE: **T1068**).

---

### Medium-term follow-ups
- **Patch governance**: Validate patch SLAs for **RMM/CI/CD/admin tooling**; require **out-of-band validation** for “incomplete patch” scenarios (e.g., N-central through 2026.3.1 impacted).
- **Exposure reduction**: Ensure **CI/CD, RMM, and admin consoles** are not internet-facing; enforce **VPN + MFA + allowlisting** and tighten reverse-proxy rules.
- **macOS hardening**: Enforce **restricted Terminal/scripting** where feasible, stronger **PPPC/MDM controls**, and user prompts for new persistence items; update phishing training to include **“paste this command”** scams.
- **Credential protections**: Review **rate-limiting/lockout** and **MFA enforcement** for apps with known brute-force weaknesses (PaperCut theme); confirm SOC playbooks for credential-stuffing spikes.
- **AppSec backlog**: Triage and patch internet-facing **Gitea/CodeIgniter/WordPress plugins**; add these to continuous external attack surface monitoring with ownership mapping.
- **Detection engineering**: Create/refresh detections for **CI pipeline tampering** (build config changes + secret access + unusual egress) and **RMM mass-action anomalies** (burst tasking across endpoints).
